description: This file defines the SetValue class, which represents a DynamoDB set (SS/NS/BS), providing methods to handle and serialize set values.

classes.name: SetValue
classes.description: Represents a DynamoDB set (SS/NS/BS) value with methods for serialization and counting elements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SetValue object with an array of values.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the set values as an array.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the set.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the set values.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the set to a format suitable for JSON encoding.
